summary: HT Fonts' long static page for Andada, a free organic-slab text serif designed for Spanish and Guaraní: nearly every specimen is an animated GIF (slideshows, style cards, character-set strips, OpenType toggles), framed by a sticky anchor header. Its distinctive core is a deep dive on the Guaraní language (the saltillo, its Unicode and the alphabet, a world map), a full OpenType feature catalogue with off/on toggles, and an orthotypography primer on figures and small caps.
